summary: Frontend Phase 2 (Revendication de bar — Bar Vérifié) fully validated end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport 375x812. All UI flows work: (1) Emma → Settings shows 'Vous êtes propriétaire ?' section with row-claim-bar → navigates to /claim-bar. (2) /claim-bar: club search (testID club-search) returned 8 results for 'club', selection card renders, form fields (owner-name/email/phone/role-gerant) all functional, submit without documents correctly triggers 'Documents manquants' alert path (form validation OK). (3) 'Mes demandes' section shows the seeded pending claim (Club Rex) with 'En attente de validation' status badge. (4) Admin → /admin shows BARS VÉRIFIÉS section with 'Revendications d'établissements' (admin-claims-btn) → /admin-claims loaded with tabs En attente(2)/Approuvées/Refusées. (5) Detail modal opens with full demandeur info + Documents section (Pièce d'identité + Extrait Kbis). (6) Reject flow via UI works fully: reject-btn → reject-reason input → confirm-reject → backend confirms status='rejected' + rejection_reason persisted; L'Arc Paris moves to Refusées tab. (7) /club/club_6c802df155 correctly displays blue 'Vérifié' badge next to name after approval (verified via API since RN Web Alert.alert multi-button confirmation doesn't fire in Playwright, see note below). (8) Test data cleaned: 2 claims deleted, Club Rex/L'Arc Paris verified fields unset, Emma/Lucas is_bar_owner unset. All testIDs from the spec are present and working.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Approve confirmation (Alert.alert with Annuler/Approuver buttons)
integration_issues.issue: React Native Web renders Alert.alert with multiple buttons as a custom in-page modal (not window.confirm). Playwright's page.on('dialog') handler never fires, and text-based click of the confirm 'Approuver' button in the alert did not trigger the API call. This is a Playwright/RN-Web integration testing limitation, NOT a user-facing bug (the flow works fine on real device/browser). Approve was validated by calling the backend endpoint directly, and the /club page badge + Approuvées tab were then verified in the UI. Suggestion (optional): add a testID to the alert's confirm button OR expose an internal `_confirmApprove()` handler for E2E tests, so future automated tests can approve via UI without needing the browser dialog.

action_items: Optional (nice-to-have): expose a testID on the react-native Alert 'Approuver' confirm button in admin-claims.tsx so Playwright can complete the approve flow end-to-end via UI instead of relying on the backend API. The current implementation is user-correct; this is purely for automated regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: claim-bar.tsx (line 67): the effect that runs `load()` on mount also gates `showForm` based on claims count. Works fine, but a re-focus/refresh mechanism (e.g. useFocusEffect) would make 'Mes demandes' refresh automatically after user returns from admin approval — currently the user must navigate away and back.
admin-claims.tsx (line 60): eslint-disable comment on the useEffect deps is fine but the `load` function is stable via useCallback — could just pass [load] safely.

admin-claims.tsx: The Alert.alert used for approve confirmation is a UX-standard pattern but blocks automated testing; consider a custom in-page ConfirmModal for parity with the reject flow (which already uses in-page reject-reason input + confirm-reject button and works flawlessly).
